messages:
Ivy Wallace: hey folks, ivy here (day 2). opened my first tiny PR but Buildkite immediately failed with a 403 during checkout. who should i ping for CI access?
Buildkite Bot: Build #1024 (ivy/docs-fix) failed · exit code 128 · logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/1024
Ivy Wallace: checkout snippet: 
```
remote: HTTP Basic: Access denied
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs.git/'
```
Priya Patel: welcome Ivy! :wave: quick checklist — accept org invite, enable SSO/2FA, add SSH key. note: many pipelines use the org deploy token for HTTPS checkout so personal SSH keys alone won't help.
Ivy Wallace: i accepted invite and added SSH key but still seeing 403. can clone over SSH locally though.
Samir Rao: hey @Ivy, Buildkite sometimes runs HTTPS checkouts using the org deploy token (rotated earlier). new hires need to be in the eng-ci team to be covered. which pipeline is it?
Ivy Wallace: pipeline is "docs/build-and-lint".
Nikhil Singh: pinged — adding Ivy to eng-ci and to the Buildkite pipeline team now. also checking GitHub App install on the repo.
GitHub Apps Bot: GitHub App "Redwood CI" granted access to redwood-inference/docs by Nikhil Singh
Ivy Wallace: re-ran and checkout passed! now failing on a pip install with a corrupted wheel error: 
```
ERROR: Could not install packages due to an OSError: [Errno 74] corrupted cached wheel
```
Priya Patel: we saw that after the base image bump. workaround: re-run with SKIP_PIP_CACHE=1 or use Buildkite manual "Clear caches".
Ivy Wallace: tried SKIP_PIP_CACHE=1, progressed further, but integration job timed out waiting for Postgres: 
```
E TimeoutError: Postgres did not start after 60s
```
Samir Rao: internal registry has been slow — set CI_DOCKER_PULL=1 or TAG=ci-latest to force fresh images, or bump job timeout. i'll bump timeout for this pipeline and add DOCKER_MAX_RETRIES=3.
Ivy Wallace: bumped timeout + re-run passed! :tada: two quick Qs: 1) for changing workflows in infra/ci-templates, do i need any special perms? 2) how do i request temporary access to pipeline secrets for a one-off infra PR?
Priya Patel: 1) you need repo write at minimum; protected branches or org-level restrictions may require maintainer approval. 2) open a short request in #eng-infra with repo+secret+expiry reason; we grant pipeline-bound secrets, not user-level secrets, and approval is required.
Ivy Wallace: perfect. marking CI access done on my onboarding checklist. thanks everyone for the fast help — saved my first-week nerves :relieved:
